Run a controlled demonstration

The operator remains signed in. A separate, non-admin simulation identity builds normal history, then requests synthetic missing pages, simulated authentication failures and a short latency endpoint. No real password guessing or exploit payloads are sent.

The first run normally takes about 70–80 minutes. There is a maximum of 180 probe requests at one per second. Existing history can shorten later runs. Production scoring thresholds are unchanged. A new session is used for every run.
